description: Create, delete, and clean up files and directories.

option.name: --boot
tip: Execute actions only safe at boot.

option.name: --cat-config
tip: Show configuration files.

option.name: --clean
tip: Clean up files and directories.

option.name: --create
tip: Create and adjust files and directories.

option.name: --dry-run
tip: Just print what would be done.

option.name: --exclude-prefix
tip: Ignore rules with the specified prefix.

option.name: --graceful
tip: Quietly ignore unknown users or groups.

option.name: --help
tip: Show this help.

option.name: --image
tip: Operate on a disk image as the filesystem root.

option.name: --image-policy
tip: Specify the disk image dissection policy.

option.name: --no-pager
tip: Do not pipe output into a pager.

option.name: --prefix
tip: Only apply rules with the specified prefix.

option.name: --purge
tip: Delete files and directories marked for creation in the specified configuration files (careful!).

option.name: --remove
tip: Remove files and directories marked for removal.

option.name: --replace
tip: Treat arguments as a replacement for PATH.

option.name: --root
tip: Operate on an alternate filesystem root.

option.name: --tldr
tip: Show non-comment parts of configuration files.

option.name: --user
tip: Execute user configuration.

option.name: --version
tip: Show package version.

option.name: -E
tip: Ignore rules prefixed with /dev, /proc, /run or /sys.
